messages:
anya (People Ops): Quick lifecycle note: we're publishing an updated Benefits & Compliance sync this week. Main items: contractor benefits clarification, updated sexual harassment training schedule, and handbook wording for "Personal Device Access". Completion window: May 10-24.

marco (Eng Manager): Do contractors need to be enrolled into benefits to be considered compliant, or just complete the training? We have a part-time contractor who does product research.

anya (People Ops): Contractors only need to complete the training to be compliant with the policy refresher. Benefits eligibility remains per contract type; the handbook PR clarifies this distinction.

saira (HRBP): Filing note: I updated the hiring checklist to add a contractor eligibility checkbox and a pointer to the hiring ops form. See PR: https://git.internal/redwood/handbook/pulls/523 — Ella, can legal skim the new clause about contractor-defined data access?

ella (Legal): Scanning now. One suggested edit: tighten the phrase "limited access" to "time-bound, role-based access with documented owner." I'll add an inline suggestion.

anya (People Ops): Thanks. Also: hr-bot will push a manager-facing digest on May 3 with a CSV export link for HRIS ingestion. Darren, payroll needs the report to validate benefits enrollment windows.

hr-bot: Scheduled export: /internal/hr/exports/benefits_compliance_2026-05-03.csv next run 2026-05-03T02:30Z :robot_face:

darren (Payroll): Perfect. For payroll sync: please include hire_date, job_type, and contractor_flag columns in the CSV. Otherwise I can't reconcile retroactive enrollments.

anya (People Ops): Will do. Nisha (HRIS) is out this week but I've added the columns to the export template.

marco (Eng Manager): Can we gate performance calibration packets on completion? We have a few late ICs last cycle and it'd help keep people accountable.

saira (HRBP): We agreed to gate calibration for mandatory compliance modules in Q2. I'll coordinate an exceptions list for people on leave or with documented accommodations.

anya (People Ops): Manager reminder scheduled: 2026-05-08. Template below — feel free to reuse: "Hi <manager>, quick reminder to confirm your team's completion of the Benefits & Compliance refresher by May 24. Update the tracker and notify HR for any exceptions."

marco (Eng Manager): Can we get a separate note to hiring for offers? We need to set expectations for start-of-employment tasks.

anya (People Ops): Offer wording suggestion for recruiting: "New hires should complete the mandatory policy refresher within 14 days of start; benefits deadlines are outlined in the onboarding portal. Contact benefits@redwood.com with questions."

ella (Legal): One more: add a short FAQ in the handbook PR about data access when using personal devices. That reduces ambiguous approvals.

anya (People Ops): Good call. I'll add a short decision table to the PR with approval owners.

hr-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: added by hr-bot

anya (People Ops): I'll post a mid-cycle status update on May 12 with completion rates per team. If managers want a CSV excerpt earlier, DM me and I'll run it.
